notes.content: [h2]A (Kind of?) Sequel to hololive Treasure Mountain Has Arrived![/h2][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/aa0c1b3cd75fda4799c1b19ddd34c779d6b4cf43.png"][/img][/h2][p]To celebrate the release of the brand-new [b]hololive GoroGoro Mountain[/b],[/p][p]a special 2-title bundle is now available:[/p][p][b]hololive Treasure & GoroGoro Double Pack[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]▶ [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56553/"]View the bundle page here[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Even if you already own [i]hololive Treasure Mountain[/i],[/p][p]you can get [i]hololive GoroGoro Mountain[/i] at [b]10% off[/b] with this bundle![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]What is "hololive GoroGoro Mountain"?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]This cheerful and colorful 3D action game is inspired by hololive’s beloved VTuber, [b]Houshou Marine[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Take on the role of one of her loyal pirate crew members,[/p][p]and roll hololive talents—yes, the “treasures” gathered by Captain Marine—[/p][p]up a mountain, merging identical ones together to grow them as you climb![/p][p][/p][p]Sometimes they’ll roll too far, or bounce off in unexpected directions…[/p][p]but that’s all part of the chaotic and heartwarming joy of this fan-filled journey![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]With two very different “mountain” experiences,[/p][p]now’s the perfect time to enjoy both titles![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56553/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511130/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: hololive GAMERS join the fray!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/fde01e3261ab51759a5ecf1979f5331f846c51ee.png[/img]A surprise update celebrating [i]hololive GAMERS fes. CHOCHOCHOCHOGAMERS 2[/i]!

[p]To celebrate the [i]hololive GAMERS fes. CHOCHOCHOCHOGAMERS 2[/i] event,[/p]
[p][b]hololive GAMERS[/b] are making a surprise appearance in [i]hololive Treasure Mountain[/i]![/p]
[p]And best of all—it’s a [b]free update[/b], available now![/p]

[h2][b]New Commentary Characters: hololive GAMERS![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/af29c14576d603670174d5a132b71cd7232a08c7.png[/img]
With this update, you can now select the brand-new commentary characters: [b]hololive GAMERS[/b]!

[p][b]Shirakami Fubuki, Ookami Mio, Nekomata Okayu[/b], and [b]Inugami Korone[/b] all appear on screen at once,[/p]
[p]delivering cheerful banter and lively reactions to make your game more exciting than ever![/p]

[p]Even the BGM gets a special makeover—switching to the vocal track [b]“We are GAMERS!!!!”[/b][/p]
[p]Feel the energy of a real festival as you play![/p]

[h2][b]Exclusive in-game voice lines—only here![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/97ebd541f5cdfbdd0fafd159ba45420ef0ee555d.png[/img]
Set one of the hololive GAMERS members as your [b]largest treasure[/b],
[p]and you’ll unlock a [b]special voice line[/b] you won’t hear anywhere else![/p]

[p]A brand-new [b]GAMERS-themed opening animation[/b] is also included,[/p]
[p]so the hype starts from the very beginning![/p]

[p]Experience the excitement of the event all over again—this time in [i]Treasure Mountain[/i]![/p]



[p]▶️ [b]Play Now[/b][/p]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2972990/
[hr][/hr]
[h3][b]⚠️ Notes[/b][/h3]
[list][*][p]To access this content, please update [i]hololive Treasure Mountain[/i] to the latest version.[/p][/*][*][p]You can change the commentary character from the title screen via[/p]
[p][b]　“Marine’s Treasures” > “Select Commentary Character”[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: “Popopopo”!?! The Polka Theater opens with the brand-new DLC!
notes.content:
Polka Theater takes the stage!
The ringmaster of dreams and chaos, Omaru Polka,
joins hololive Treasure Mountain as a playable Commentary Character in response to overwhelming fan demand!
With the brand-new "POPOPOPO DLC", the “world’s gentlest chaos” of Omaru Polka explodes into action!
The circus goes on, endlessly.
And the next stage… is right beside you!

[h2]New Commentary Character: Omaru Polka![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/557cd9e0cad20bb862b665ce8e883b764b38d5ff.png[/img]
Apply the "POPOPOPO DLC" to unlock the new Commentary Character Omaru Polka!
Set Polka as your commentary character, and she’ll appear on screen during gameplay—  
with her very own BGM, “HOLOGRAM CIRCUS”, setting the tone for a wild and whimsical Polka performance.  
Once that music hits, you know the Polka Theater is in full swing.  
Let the chaotic and charming show begin!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/d8bfe93e96f5ec0174e660cd63f971a6863b8e48.png[/img]
Why did Omaru Polka come to Houshou Marine’s island in the first place?  
It’s a long story... or is it?  
Either way, don’t miss the brand-new Polka-themed opening cutscene!

Dive into a Polka-packed Treasure Mountain full of high-energy chaos!  
You never know what she’ll say next—so get ready for a full-throttle Polka Theater experience!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3519010/__DLC/


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3519000/__DLC/  
Don't miss “SUKONNA DLC” featuring Shirakami Fubuki, too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3157450/__DLC/  
And of course, “Hiya-Peko DLC” featuring Usada Pekora is ready and waiting—peko!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2972990/_/

"Marine's Treasures" > "Select Commentator"

notes.title: Major Update Arrives in Treasure Mountain!
notes.content:
[h1]Update Details[/h1]

[h2]Versus Mode[/h2]
Two unique game rules for even more fun!

[h3]Versus Mode ①: "Treasure Race"[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/b351843fd3869378144ffbd5cbb3ddbf07bcec5c.png[/img]
The player who completes the "biggest treasure" faster than their opponent wins!
This thrilling mode tests your speed and decision-making as you race to grow treasures quickly without letting them fall into the sea!

[b]"Treasure Race" Special Rules
[list]
[*] If time runs out, the player with the larger treasure wins.
[*] Dropping treasures off the island doesn’t result in game over; you restart from the state of the largest treasure.
[/list]

[h3]Versus Mode ②: "Score Attack"[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/384393106e4a07fb8d606e9a7a5aed33db31fa64.png[/img]
The player who earns the most points within the time limit wins!
Throw treasures faster than usual and compete in a heated back-and-forth battle for points!

[b]"Score Attack" Special Rules
[list]
[*] Dropping treasures off the island doesn’t result in game over.
[*] Treasures spawn on the island periodically.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]How to Play Versus Mode[/h2]
Versus Mode can be played in three ways:
[olist]
[*] Online matches with friends
[*] Online matches using invitation links
[*] Local matches on a single PC
[/olist]

[h3]Method 1: Online Matches with Friends[/h3]
Play with friends using Steam®'s Remote Play Together feature.
[olist]
[*] From the Treasure Mountain title screen, select "Start Game" > "Versus Play" > "Online Match."
[list]
[*] The [b]Remote Play Together[/b] window will open.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/5d56942db2b07e9f0a0f5e88f229d5e8f61be7f7.png[/img]
[/list]
[*] Select "Invite Friend" from the left menu, and choose a friend from the right-hand list.
[list]
[*] A Steam invitation message will be sent to the selected friend.
[*] Players invited via Remote Play Together can participate even if they don’t own Treasure Mountain.
[/list]
[*] After sending the invite, click "Return to Game" in the top-right corner of the window.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/54464d39303a610530a6a87374d8480ff23ab4f0.png[/img]
[*] Wait on the standby screen for your invited friend to join the game.
[list]
[*] Once your friend joins, their information will appear at the bottom-right of the screen.
[*] Both players (1P/2P) must confirm their input devices to begin the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/99d42b7f924e953015a1196b2055f3332a1dafac.png[/img]
[/list]
[*] Players connecting via Remote Play can only use controllers. Keyboards and mice are not supported.

[*] Select the game mode and start your match.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/450531cf4054de5cdbb19454df5bfe7ced911d76.png[/img]
[/olist]

[h3]Method 2: Online Matches Using Invitation Links[/h3]
Invite non-friends to play by generating an invitation link through Steam®’s Remote Play Together feature.
[olist]
[*] From the title screen, select "Start Game" > "Versus Play" > "Online Match."
[list][*] The [b]Remote Play Together[/b] window will open.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/5d56942db2b07e9f0a0f5e88f229d5e8f61be7f7.png[/img]
[/list]
[*] Open the Remote Play Together window and select "Invite Guest."

[*] Copy the invitation link displayed at the top of the list.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/ed9901dc90c823bc9c40df1c65bb419db41a1225.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Click "Copy" to copy the link.
[/list]
[*] Share the copied link with the opponent.
[list]
[*] Opponents can join Remote Play Together by clicking the link.
[list]
[*] A Steam® account is required for the opponent.
[*] Opponents do not need to own Treasure Mountain to play.
[/list]
[/list]
[*] Click "Return to Game" and wait for your invited player to join.
[list]
[*] When the opponent joins, their information will appear at the bottom-right of the screen.
[/list]
[/olist]

[h3]Method 3: Local Matches on a Single PC[/h3]
Play together on one PC.
[olist]
[*] From the title screen, select "Start Game" > "Versus Play" > "Offline Match."
[*] Confirm input devices for 1P and 2P to begin.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/d7a1a558bdc20d973d43174bea7913aa3417019a.png[/img]
[*] Choose a game mode and start your match.
[/olist]

[h2]Versus Mode Features[/h2]

[h3]Stamps[/h3]
Spice up Versus Mode with adorable and expressive stamps to enhance communication!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/e6a1d819ca806cb6ef4523ae79cc5a993be2c7f0.png[/img]

[h3]Handicap Settings[/h3]
The "Treasure Race" mode includes handicap options for varied player levels, a fun choice for party play!

[h3]Solo Practice[/h3]
A training mode to familiarize yourself with the rules before trying a match.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/39a894b3443626db90b7e3586f2b3f146c644b96.png[/img]

[h2]Versus Mode Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Progress toward unlocking treasures or achievements does not count in Versus Mode.
[*] Players using Remote Play Together must use a controller. Keyboards and mice are not supported.
[*] Due to Remote Play Together restrictions, Mac users cannot host games but can join invitations.
[*] For more details on Remote Play Together, check [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay]Steam Remote Play[/url].
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Unlock Treasures with a Free "Treasure Unlock Ticket"![/h2]
As part of the major update celebration, we’re thrilled to gift every player a special Treasure Unlock Ticket that lets you unlock one unopened treasure!
Use it to unlock your favorite treasure and enjoy Treasure Mountain even more!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/6dc3f20b306a1806cb3d71b9977bcf297959bb02.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Treasure Unlock Tickets can be used in the "Treasure Index" to unlock unopened treasures.
[*] Check your ticket count in the "Treasure Encyclopedia."
[*] Tickets will be distributed during future events on an irregular basis.
[/list]

For more details on Update Ver. 2.0.0, see the patch notes below:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2972990/view/4477236636060483623]Patch Notes Link[/url]

notes.title: Notification Update(Ver.2.0.0)
notes.content:
[h2]Update Announcement[/h2]
We have released Ver.2.0.0, which includes the following updates.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]New Game Mode: ‘Versus Play’ Added[/h2]
You can now play two types of versus game modes: “Treasure Race” and “Score Attack.”
From the ‘Treasure Mountain’ title screen, select “Start Game” > “Versus Play” to enjoy the new modes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/5370d3f56286ef52d71741736adb7d62647302a3.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Progress towards treasure unlock conditions and achievements will not apply when playing Versus Mode.
[*]Game modes from before Ver.2.0.0 can still be played by selecting “Single Play.”
[*]For more details about Versus Mode, please check the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2972990/view/4477236636060483621]Update News[/url].
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]’Treasure Unlock Ticket’ Now Available[/h2]
The ‘Treasure Unlock Ticket’ is a special ticket that can unlock one locked treasure.
As part of this update celebration, we’re gifting all players one Treasure Unlock Ticket!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/6dc3f20b306a1806cb3d71b9977bcf297959bb02.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Treasure Unlock Tickets will be distributed occasionally during future events.
[*]Treasure Unlock Tickets can be used in the ‘Treasure Index’.
[*]When unlocking a treasure with a ticket, its unlock condition will not progress, so you must meet the specified conditions to obtain related Steam achievements.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Default volume settings have been adjusted.
These changes will only apply when new save data is created after the Ver.2.0.0 update.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support of “Hololive Treasure Mountain".

notes.title: More News! Treasure Mountain: Major Update Info Part 2!
notes.content:
The upcoming 2.0.0 update is scheduled for release on December 3rd.
Let’s take a look at the two new game modes planned for this update.

Versus Mode 1: 'Treasure Race'
The first to complete the "biggest treasure" wins!
This is a fast-paced treasure-making race that requires speed and decision-making.
Be careful not to stack too quickly and let your treasures fall into the sea!

Versus Mode 2: 'Score Attack'
The player who earns the most points within the time limit wins!
In this mode, dropping treasures into the sea won’t end the game, so toss treasures freely and rack up points like crazy!

We’re also planning to add cute stamp features to make the battles even more exciting.
Check out the PV for the Treasure Mountain Major Update for more details!
[previewyoutube=jDJ3sEW1CcU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.content:

[h3]The "Versus Mode" is finally coming to Treasure Mountain![/h3]

In the upcoming Treasure Mountain 2.0.0 update, we’re planning to add a new Versus Mode for two players to play simultaneously.

Versus Mode allows two players to play together on a single PC, and with Steam's "Remote Play Together" feature, you can also challenge friends or players online!

The 2.0.0 update is scheduled for release on December 3rd. Twice the fun awaits! Stay tuned for more details on the exciting new gameplay in Versus Mode!

notes.title: "Usada Pekora" Joins the Fight as a Commentator!? The Long-Awaited DLC!
notes.content:
Konpeko, konpeko, konpekooo!
The incredibly popular hololive talent "Usada Pekora" is making her debut in
"hololive Treasure Mountain" as a commentary character!

[h2]◆ Commentary Character: "Usada Pekora"[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/2530fda384174fc579b03b5ebf644bfeda0974b2.png[/img]
You will now be able to select Usada Pekora as a commentary character.
When you set Usada Pekora as your commentary character,
she will appear on screen during gameplay, delivering her energetic commentary alongside a brand-new Pekora-themed BGM!
Additionally, when playing with Usada Pekora as the commentary character,
the treasure voice will change when you create "the biggest treasure."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110066/4e633e223a4caeb4760439230a13fe82031b3711.png[/img]
There's also a must-see new Pekora-themed opening where Usada Pekora takes over the island!
Enjoy a fully Pekora-packed Treasure Mountain to your heart's content, peko~!

notes.title: Patch Release Notification (Ver.1.0.1)
notes.content:
[b]Announcement[/b]
- We have released patch Ver.1.0.1,  which fixes the following issues.


[b]Fix Details[/b]
- We have fixed an issue where the game would set an unintended language based on the Steam application’s language settings, causing the game to malfunction. This issue affected the following languages:
   -    French
   -    Italian
   -   German
   -   Spanish
   -    Portuguese
   -   Russian
   -   Korean
- Please note that there are no issues with Japanese, English, and Chinese (Simplified/Traditional).
    

Additional Information

- We will continue to address other reported bugs and issues as we move forward.


Thank you.
